question.text:

' B ' gives effervescence with aq. $\mathrm{NaHCO}_3$.
'C' gives fruity smell.

solution.text:
A $\rightarrow$ Benzamide Shows positive Lassaigh's test.
$B \rightarrow$ Benzoic acid gives effervescence with aq.
$\mathrm{NaHCO}_3$.
